dangerZone.resetPasswordDesc: Clear master password and encryption keys. You'll need to set a new password.
dangerZone.resetPasswordConfirmMsg:
⚠️ This will clear your master password and encryption keys.

After reset, you'll need to set a new master password to use encryption.

Note: Encrypted notes will remain encrypted and cannot be decrypted without the original password.
dangerZone.resetPasswordSuccessMsg: ✓ Master password has been cleared. You can now set a new password by enabling encryption.
dangerZone.purgeLocalDesc: Clears ALL local notebooks and notes from this device.
dangerZone.purgeConfirmMsg:
⚠️ DANGER: This will DELETE ALL local notebooks and notes from this device!

This includes:
  • All notebooks and notes
  • All deleted items (recycle bin)
  • Local sync history
This action cannot be undone. Are you absolutely sure you want to continue?
dangerZone.purgeSuccessStatus: ✓ Local data purged successfully! Click "Sync Now" to download from server.
dangerZone.purgeSuccessMsgConnected:
Local data purged successfully!

Next steps:
  1. Click 'Sync Now' to download all data from Nextcloud
  2. Wait for sync to complete
  3. Your notes will be restored from the server
dangerZone.warningConnected: ⚠️ This action will delete all local data including notebooks, notes, and sync history. If you are connected to Nextcloud, you can restore your data by syncing again. Unsynced changes will be permanently lost.
dangerZone.warningDisconnected: ⚠️ This action will delete all local data including notebooks, notes, and sync history. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

encryption.enabledNextcloudMsg:

Important: Encrypted notes cannot be read in Nextcloud's web interface or other clients.
encryption.disabledNextcloudMsg: Nextcloud encryption disabled. Notes will be synced as plain text.
